title: A lead whose Time Clock is turned off keeps a named column that takes no drops
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technician "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim" is active at this location with the "Technician" role and "Time Clock" on; he was made for this case only, because this test turns his Time Clock off.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Time Clock Off" has two Approved work orders: unit "N1-U1" led by "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim", and unit "N1-U2" with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: your initials (top right) > "Settings" > "Staff", in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil icon on "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim".
  2. Turn "Time Clock" off and click "Save & Close".
  3. Go to "Work Orders" > "All" > "Board View".
  4. Type "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Time Clock Off" in "Search".
  5. Drag the card for unit "N1-U2" from "Unassigned" onto "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim"'s column and let go.
  6. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  7. Click the row for unit "N1-U1" to open its work order.
  8. Set "Lead Technician" to "Unassigned".
  9. Go to "Work Orders" > "All" > "Board View".
  10. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the staff record of "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim" opens.

Step 2: the record saves with "Time Clock" off.

Step 3: Board View shows.

Step 4: unit "N1-U1" is still in a column of its own headed "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim".

Step 5: the drop is refused: unit "N1-U2" stays in "Unassigned" and the column still holds only unit "N1-U1".

Step 6: unit "N1-U1" is in a group headed "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim".

Step 7: the work order page for unit "N1-U1" opens.

Step 8: "Lead Technician" reads "Unassigned".

Step 9: Board View shows no column for "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim".

Step 10: Tech View shows no group for "ZZAUTOTEST N1 Tim".
